text: We share in communion and reverently remember first of all the glorious Mary, ever Virgin, Mother of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ, and also blessed Joseph, spouse of that same Virgin, and your blessed Apostles and Martyrs Peter and Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon and Thaddeus; Linus, Cletus, Clement, Sixtus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian; and all your Saints. Through their merits and prayers, grant that in all things we may be fortified by the help of your protection.
